result.topic_en: Calculation splitting a function u into two parts u_1 = ½(u − Δu) and u_2 = ½(u + Δu) satisfying Helmholtz-type equations Δu_1 + u_1 = 0 and Δu_2 − u_2 = 0, then integrating against cos√(1−λ)x and cos√(−1−λ)x over (−a, a) to obtain conditions on the coefficients A and B.
result.transcription:
$u \cos\sqrt{1-\lambda}\,a$

$\int\left(\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial y^2}+(\lambda-?)\,u\right)\cos\sqrt{1-\lambda}\,x\,\partial x$

$u_1=\frac12\left(u-\left(\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial x^2}+\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial y^2}\right)\right)$ $\quad\frac{\partial^2 u_1}{\partial x^2}+\frac{\partial^2 u_1}{\partial y^2}+u_1=0$
$u_2=\frac12\left(u+\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial x^2}+\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial y^2}\right)$ $\quad\frac{\partial^2 u_2}{\partial x^2}+\frac{\partial^2 u_2}{\partial y^2}-u_2=0$

$A\int_{-a}^{+a}u_1\cos\sqrt{1-\lambda}\,x\,\partial x = A\sqrt{1-\lambda}\sin\sqrt{1-\lambda}\,a\cos\sqrt{1-\beta}\,a\cos\sqrt{-1-\beta}\,a\,\frac{(\beta+\nu)}{\beta-\lambda}\,2c$
$+B\int_{-a}^{+a}u_2\cos\sqrt{-1-\lambda}\,x\,\partial x\quad + B\sqrt{-1-\lambda}\sin\sqrt{-1-\lambda}\,a\quad -\frac{\beta-\nu}{\beta-\lambda}\,2c$
$-A\quad\cos\sqrt{1-\lambda}\,a\sin\sqrt{1-\beta}\,a\cos\sqrt{-1-\beta}\,a\,\frac{\sqrt{1-\beta}\,(\beta+\nu)}{\beta-\lambda}$
$-B\quad\cos\sqrt{-1-\lambda}\,a\sin\sqrt{1-\beta}\,a\cos\sqrt{-1-\beta}\,a\,\frac{\sqrt{1-\beta}\,(\beta+\nu)}{(\beta-\lambda)\,\beta-\nu}\,2c$

$A\sqrt{1-\lambda}\sin\sqrt{1-\lambda}\,a\,(\lambda+\nu)-B\sqrt{-1-\lambda}\sin\sqrt{-1-\lambda}\,a\,(\lambda-\nu)=0$
$A(\lambda-\nu)\cos\sqrt{1-\lambda}\,a\quad -B(\lambda+\nu)\cos\sqrt{-1-\lambda}\,a\;=0$

$=\sqrt{1-\lambda}\sin\sqrt{1-\lambda}\,a\cos\sqrt{-1-\lambda}\,a\left[\lambda+\nu-\frac{(\lambda+\nu)^2}{\lambda-\nu}\right]\cos\sqrt{1-\beta}\,a\cos\sqrt{-1-\beta}\,a\;2c$

$+\cos\sqrt{1-\lambda}\,a\cos\sqrt{-1-\lambda}\,a\,.\,2\nu\qquad\sqrt{1-\beta}\sin\sqrt{1-\beta}\,a\cos\sqrt{-1-\beta}\,a\;2c$

$-2\nu\left(\frac{\lambda+\nu}{\lambda-\nu}\right)\qquad\left(\frac{\lambda+\nu}{\beta-\nu}\right)$

$-A\cos\sqrt{1-\lambda}\,a\left(\frac{\beta-\nu}{\beta-\lambda}\right)+B\cos\sqrt{-1-\lambda}\,a\,\frac{\beta+\nu}{\beta-\lambda}$

methods.what: Decomposition of u into components satisfying Helmholtz and modified Helmholtz equations
methods.quote: $u_1=\frac12\left(u-\left(\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial x^2}+\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial y^2}\right)\right)$ $\quad\frac{\partial^2 u_1}{\partial x^2}+\frac{\partial^2 u_1}{\partial y^2}+u_1=0$

methods.what: Projection of u_1, u_2 onto cosine modes over (−a,a), evaluated in closed form
Linear system of boundary conditions for coefficients A, B (eigenvalue condition)
